# Prisma

A bot using **Prisma ORM** and TypeScript for type-safe database access.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://www.prisma.io/" title="Prisma" description="Next-generation ORM." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/prisma-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Configure database connection in `.env`:

```bash
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mybot"
```

Run migrations:

```bash
npx prisma migrate dev
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Prisma ORM integration
- Type-safe database queries
- Auto-generated client
- Database migrations

## Schema Example

```prisma title="prisma/schema.prisma"
model User {
  id        String   @id
  balance   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}
```
